content.query:
use bronze;
go
create external data source json_format 
with(
    location = 'adls-synapse01/json/US_STATE_recipes.json',
    file_format = csv_format,
)



select top 10*
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'adls-synapse01/json/US_STATE_recipes.json',
    DATA_SOURCE = 'bronze_source',
    FORMAT = 'CSV', -- Treated as a single-row CSV to ingest raw string data chunks
    FIELDTERMINATOR = '0x0b', 
    ROWTERMINATOR = '0x0b',
    FIELDQUOTE = '0x0b'
) WITH (json_payload VARCHAR(MAX)) AS [file]
CROSS APPLY OPENJSON([file].json_payload, '$.root') AS recipes;
GO
